name: 47711 · Evansville, IN
findings: ZIP 47711 (Evansville) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47711 (Evansville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
